div.p: The short answers. Anything else — call 800 AABAN and ask.

details.p: Complaint visits are same-day in Dubai and within 24–48 hours in the other emirates. Around Ajman we usually have same or next-day slots for new bookings.

details.summary: Are the chemicals safe for my family and pets?
details.p: We only use MOCCAE-approved pesticides, applied by trained, municipality-approved technicians. The technician tells you before the visit what precautions apply — usually keeping children and pets away from treated areas until dry.

details.summary: What if the pests come back after a treatment?
details.p: Contract clients get free follow-up visits every 3 days until the infestation clears — that's in the agreement, not a favour.

details.summary: What is Dubai LO 11 and does my restaurant need it?
details.p: Local Order 11 of 2003 is Dubai Municipality's public-health regulation. Food businesses in Dubai need a pest-control contract with an approved company — 2 visits per month — and monthly reporting to the municipality. We hold the Public Health Pest Control Agreement and handle the returns for you.

ul.li: Water tank cleaning — a cleaning certificate for building compliance after every clean.
Anti-termite treatment — a written 10-year warranty certificate on completion.
Every visit closes with a service report.

details.p: Prices come from our signed rate card and are fixed before the visit — residential pest control by property size (AED 200–320/visit), water tanks from AED 0.35/gallon, anti-termite AED 14.50–18.00/m². No surprises on site.

details.summary: What does an annual contract (AMC) include?
details.p: A yearly programme of 12, 4 or 2 visits scheduled in advance, free follow-ups until any infestation clears, priority complaint response, and municipality reporting where it applies. One invoice, one number to call.
Ajman (head of operations), Sharjah and Dubai.
